A lot of breads have sugar. Fruit has sugar. Want to get a nice carmeliazaion on some meat? Has to have sugar. Sugar is awesome, as long as you don't overeat it.

Also between using sugar or honey to sweeten something, like tea or coffee, I would recommend using honey. It's a lot more natural (less processed) and tastes way better. It's also more expensive than cane sugar which means you will probably ration a bottle of honey and try to use less.
